title: why ZooKeeper made me question everything I thought I knew about consensus
content:
so it dropped casually

the assignment said implement leader election like it costs nothing. four hours later I was questioning everything.

LeaderLatch latch = new LeaderLatch(curator, "/election");
latch.start();
if (latch.hasLeadership()) {
  doLeaderThings();
}
a distributed system is one in which the failure of a computer you didn't even know existed can render your own computer unusable — leslie lamport

anyway. I get it now. barely. nuon witnessed the whole breakdown.
